title: Tepper and Avati in Illustration Mag
content: The newIllustration Magazine(Vol. 14 #56) has feature articles on Saul Tepper and James Avati.Like Dean Cornwell and Harold von Schmidt,Saul Tepper(1899-1987) was a student of Harvey Dunn.James Avati(1912-2005) was best known for his paperback covers for American novels by mainstream writers like William Faulkner, Pearl Buck and Erskine Caldwell. His smoky, sultry young men and women promised drama and danger, and his composition and lighting choices were always fresh and interesting.Here's more info:Illustration Magazine
